description: This file is a Python script for generating C++ code related to mobile upgrader functions in PyTorch. It defines classes, templates, and functions to construct and write C++ source code for operator version upgrades.

classes.name: ByteCode
classes.description: Enumeration for different bytecode components such as instructions, constants, types, operators, and register size.

methods.name: construct_instruction
methods.description: Constructs instruction list string from YAML data.

methods.name: construct_constants
methods.description: Constructs constants list string from YAML data.

methods.name: construct_operators
methods.description: Constructs operators list string from YAML data.

methods.name: construct_types
methods.description: Constructs types list string from YAML data.

methods.name: construct_register_size
methods.description: Converts register size from YAML data to string.

methods.name: construct_version_maps
methods.description: Builds version map string for operator upgrades.

methods.name: get_upgrader_bytecode_function_to_index_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from upgrader names to bytecode function indices.

methods.name: write_cpp
methods.description: Generates and writes the C++ source file for mobile upgrader functions.

methods.name: sort_upgrader
methods.description: Sorts upgrader list based on their keys.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to generate upgrader bytecode and write C++ file.
